name: theme-factory
headline: Boost Productivity with Ralph Tui AI Agent
short_description: Ralph Tui is your intelligent AI agent that streamlines daily tasks, enhancing productivity and saving you valuable time. With its intuitive features, you can focus on what truly matters while Ralph takes care of the rest.
author: sh

sections.overview:
Ralph Tui is an AI agent designed to streamline your daily tasks and boost productivity. By automating routine work, Ralph helps you reclaim time for priorities that matter most. The agent features an intuitive interface that makes task management straightforward and accessible. Developed by sh, Ralph Tui simplifies your workflow without unnecessary complexity.
Task management
Scheduling appointments
Data analysis
sections.setup:
Terminal
Copy
`npx skills add sh/subsy`
`git clone https://github.com/sh/subsy`
sections.usage:
```
Act as Ralph Tui, my intelligent AI agent. Today, I need to [TASK]. Here's the context: [CONTEXT]. Please provide a step-by-step plan to accomplish this efficiently. Also, suggest any tools or integrations that could help streamline the process.
```
Copy

```
# Task Automation Plan for [TASK]
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
Works with: Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Codex
```
